_comment: Offsets are days from 'now' at load time so the demo never goes stale.

events.title: Kyoto Python Night — LT & Pizza
events.description: Five-minute lightning talks on Python, data and side projects, then pizza and beer. Beginners very welcome, talks in English and Japanese.

events.title: Osaka [Umeda] Language Exchange — 大阪英語会
events.location: Cafe near Umeda Station, Kita-ku, Osaka
events.description: Small-group English/Japanese exchange, max 10 people, question cards to keep the conversation moving. Great for a first meetup in Osaka.

events.title: Kobe Harborland Sunset Run (5K / 10K)
events.description: Easy-paced group run along Kobe's waterfront finishing at the port tower, with an optional ramen stop afterwards.

events.title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove & Mt. Ogura Hike
events.description: Half-day hike from the bamboo grove up Mt. Ogura for a view over the Hozu river valley. Moderate pace, roughly 8 km.

events.title: Osaka AI Builders — LLM Agents in Production
events.description: Three talks on shipping LLM agents: retrieval that actually works, evals, and cost control. Networking with local startups afterwards.

events.title: Nishiki Market Evening Food Crawl
events.description: Six stops through Kyoto's kitchen: tamagoyaki, yuba, tsukemono and a standing sake bar to finish. Small friendly group of locals and visitors.

events.title: Kansai Rust Meetup #12
events.description: 関西のRustユーザーが集まる勉強会。今回は非同期ランタイムとWebAssemblyの実践事例を中心にLT形式で発表します。

events.title: Kobe Jazz Night at Sannomiya
events.location: Live house in Sannomiya, Chuo-ku, Kobe
events.description: Kobe invented Japanese jazz — hear a local quartet play standards in a tiny basement club, with a jam session at the end of the night.

events.title: Kyoto Startup Pitch & Coffee
events.description: Six early-stage founders pitch for five minutes each, followed by open feedback and flat whites. Investors and curious engineers both welcome.

events.title: Osaka Castle Park International Picnic
events.description: Bring something to share and meet people from twenty-odd countries on the lawn under the castle keep. Frisbees, board games and kids welcome.

events.title: Tea Ceremony Workshop for Beginners — 茶道体験
events.description: A relaxed two-hour introduction to chado in a restored machiya: whisk your own matcha, learn the etiquette, English explanation throughout.

events.title: Mt. Rokko Sunrise Hike
events.description: Early start up the Tekkosaido trail to catch sunrise over Osaka Bay, then coffee at the top and the cable car back down.

events.title: Namba Board Game Night
events.location: Board game cafe, Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka
events.description: Two hundred games on the shelf, hosts who teach the rules, and a mixed Japanese/English crowd. Turn up alone and you will be at a table in five minutes.

events.title: Kansai Data Engineering Night
events.description: Talks on streaming pipelines, dbt at scale and one honest post-mortem of a warehouse migration that went sideways.

events.title: Nara Park Morning Walk & Todai-ji
events.description: Beat the crowds: deer at dawn, the Great Buddha hall, then Kasuga-taisha's lantern paths before lunch in Naramachi.

events.title: Kyoto Frontend Friday — React & Web Perf
events.description: Hands-on evening on React server components and Core Web Vitals, with laptops open and a shared repo to hack on.

events.title: English Stand-Up Comedy Night Osaka
events.description: Eight comics, mostly expats, doing tight ten-minute sets about life in Japan. Open mic slots for anyone brave enough.

events.title: Nada Sake Brewery Tour — 灘五郷 酒蔵めぐり
events.description: 灘五郷の酒蔵を三軒めぐる見学ツアー。仕込み水の飲み比べと利き酒つき。English guide available.

events.title: Fushimi Inari Night Photo Walk
events.description: Shoot the torii gates after dark with almost nobody around. Tripods encouraged, and someone always knows the quiet side trails.

events.title: Kansai Go Developers — 関西Gopher会
events.description: 関西のGopherが集まる勉強会。今回のテーマは並行処理のデバッグと、実運用でのプロファイリング事例です。
